name: hermex-fixture-all-rule-types
description: A repo engineered so every one of the ten rule types fires at once, which no other fixture does (require-repo-name-match compares this name against a remote supplied by the case setup, since git cannot track a .git path here): `license` is missing (require-package-fields), `publishConfig.registry` is present (no-package-fields), engines.node is below the required range (require-engine-version), `build` and `test` scripts are absent (require-scripts), moment is declared (no-packages), typescript is not (require-packages), jest.config.js and .babelrc exist (no-files), .nvmrc does not (require-files), and CODEOWNERS leaves one file unowned and another owned by the wrong team (codeowners, twice).
